name: voyage

attributes.attribute: a hero travel account at sea
the hero meets terrifying Otherworld women
a distinct form that pays less attention to the journey

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: The voyage is a form of Celtic narrative. The Voyage of Maelduin is one famous account. While at sea the hero meets several terrible Otherworld women. The adventure is a like but distinct form. It also recounts travel to the Otherworld. The journey itself matters less to it. A factual account cares mainly about the destination.

okr.objective: The voyage is a Celtic narrative of travel to the Otherworld.
key_results: The Voyage of Maelduin is a famous voyage account.
The hero meets terrible Otherworld women at sea.
The adventure is a similar but distinct form.
The adventure focuses on the destination, not the trip.
